title: NF Hub Combat Script
features:
NF Hub Blockspin Combat Script Features: 

Visuals — Player ESP (Boxes, Names, Distance), Box Color Picker, Enable Tracers, Tracer Color Picker,
Config Save/Load System, FPS Counter (Color Coded Green/Yellow/Red), Ping Display (Color Coded)

Combat — Aimbot, Wall Check (Raycast-based), FOV Size Slider (0-500), FOV Circle, FOV Color Picker,
Triggerbot (Auto-Fire on Target), Triggerbot Delay Slider (0-500ms)

Misc — Camera FOV Slider (70-120), Anti-AFK


Tested On Xeno, Solara And Velocity
